description: Four-page English master services agreement between two fictitious companies, typeset with Typst 0.15 (justified Libertinus Serif with hyphenation, fi/ff/ffi ligatures, small-caps party names, automatic clause numbering and two footnotes). Edits: a best-efforts wording change, the monthly fee, the late-payment interest rate inside footnote 1, the Non-Solicitation clause moved from after Fees and Payment to after Limitation of Liability, a warranty disclaimer sentence deleted, a survival sentence inserted, the death and personal injury carve-out set in bold, and the subcontracting consent wording. Consequences only: clauses 7 to 11 are renumbered 6 to 10 and Non-Solicitation becomes clause 11, paragraphs re-flow and the clause text on pages 2 to 4 shifts between pages; the running header and footer are unchanged. Producer: Typst 0.15.0 (Python package typst 0.15.0), fonts embedded in the PDF: Libertinus Serif Regular and Bold (bundled with Typst). Synthetic sample: all parties, places and figures are fictitious.
